                    const willShow = !options.classList.contains('visible');
                    closeAllThemeOptions();
                    if (willShow) {
                        options.classList.add('visible');
                        addScrollListener();
                    } else {
                        removeScrollListener();
                    }
                });
            }
        });

        // Close all open theme-options
        function closeAllThemeOptions() {
            document.querySelectorAll('.theme-options.visible').forEach(el => {
                el.classList.remove('visible');
            });
        }

        // Global click listener to close mobile dropdowns
        document.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
            if (!e.target.closest('.theme-switcher-mobile')) {
                closeAllThemeOptions();
            }
        });

        function loadDarkCSS() {
            document.documentElement.classList.add('dark');

            darkCSSUrls.forEach(href => {
                if (!document.querySelector(`link[href="${href}"]`)) {
                    const link = document.createElement('link');
                    link.rel = 'stylesheet';
                    link.href = href;
                    document.head.appendChild(link);
                }
            });
        }

        function unloadDarkCSS() {
            document.documentElement.classList.remove('dark');

            darkCSSUrls.forEach(href => {
                const link = document.querySelector(`link[href="${href}"]`);
                if (link) {
                    link.remove();
                }
            });
        }

        function applyTheme(theme) {
            if (theme === 'dark') {
                loadDarkCSS();
            } else if (theme === 'light') {
                unloadDarkCSS();
            } else if (theme === 'system') {
                const prefersDark = window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').matches;
                prefersDark ? loadDarkCSS() : unloadDarkCSS();
            }
        }

        function updateActiveButtons(theme) {
            allThemeButtons.forEach(btn =>
                btn.classList.toggle('active', btn.dataset.theme === theme)
            );
        }

        function handleThemeChange(theme) {
            localStorage.setItem('theme', theme);
            applyTheme(theme);
            updateActiveButtons(theme);
            closeAllThemeOptions();
        }

        // Initial theme application
        const savedTheme = localStorage.getItem('theme') || 'system';
        applyTheme(savedTheme);
        updateActiveButtons(savedTheme);

        // Button click handling
        allThemeButtons.forEach(btn => {
            btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
                handleThemeChange(btn.dataset.theme);
            });
        });

        // React to system preference change
        window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').addEventListener('change', () => {
            const currentTheme = localStorage.getItem('theme') || 'system';
            if (currentTheme === 'system') applyTheme('system');
        });
    });
</script>

    (function () {
        var modal = document.getElementById('appDlModal');
        var openButton = document.getElementById('headerAppButton');
        if (!modal || !openButton) {
            return;
        }

        var content = modal.querySelector('.app-dl-content');

        function showModal() {
            modal.classList.add('app-dl-modal-visible');
            document.body.classList.add('body-no-scroll');
        }

        function hideModal() {
            modal.classList.remove('app-dl-modal-visible');
            document.body.classList.remove('body-no-scroll');
        }

        openButton.addEventListener('click', function (event) {
            event.preventDefault();
            showModal();
        });

        document.getElementById('appDlClose').addEventListener('click', hideModal);

        modal.addEventListener('click', function (event) {
            // The wrap column also catches clicks above/below the card, so anything
            // outside the card itself counts as a backdrop click.
            if (content && !content.contains(event.target)) {
                hideModal();
            }
        });

        document.addEventListener('keydown', function (event) {
            if (event.key === 'Escape' && modal.classList.contains('app-dl-modal-visible')) {
                hideModal();
            }
        });
    })();
</script>

<script >
    (function () {
        var modal = document.getElementById('socialTermsModal');
        var checkbox = document.getElementById('socialTermsCheckbox');
        var marketingCheckbox = document.getElementById('socialTermsMarketing');
        var submitBtn = document.getElementById('socialTermsSubmit');
        var closeBtn = document.getElementById('socialTermsClose');
        var textEl = document.getElementById('socialTermsText');
        var content = modal.querySelector('.rmd-modal-content');
        var pendingRetry = null;
        var isLoading = false;

        // Carry over the choice the user already made on the Login/Register page, if any.
        function pageMarketingOptIn() {
            var pageCheckbox = document.getElementById('MarketingOptIn');
            return pageCheckbox !== null && pageCheckbox.checked;
        }

        function setLoading(loading) {
            isLoading = loading;
            submitBtn.disabled = loading || !checkbox.checked;
            submitBtn.className = loading ? 'btn-modal-cta social-terms-modal-cta-loading' : 'btn-modal-cta';
            checkbox.disabled = loading;
            marketingCheckbox.disabled = loading;
            closeBtn.disabled = loading;
        }

        window.showSocialTermsModal = function (provider, retry) {
            pendingRetry = retry;
            checkbox.checked = false;
            marketingCheckbox.checked = pageMarketingOptIn();
            setLoading(false);
            submitBtn.disabled = true;
            textEl.textContent = textEl.getAttribute('data-template').replace('{0}', provider);
            modal.className = 'social-terms-modal social-terms-modal-visible';
            document.body.classList.add('body-no-scroll');
        };

        // Callers invoke this when the retried login ends without navigating away
        // (server error, blocked account), so the user can adjust and try again.
        window.resetSocialTermsModal = function () {
            setLoading(false);
        };

        // One Tap logins can finish without a navigation, so callers dismiss the
        // modal outright once the account is created.
        window.hideSocialTermsModal = function () {
            setLoading(false);
            pendingRetry = null;
            modal.className = 'social-terms-modal';
            document.body.classList.remove('body-no-scroll');
        };

        function closeModal() {
            // While the retried request is in flight the account may still get created
            // server-side, so dismissing the modal would lie about the outcome.
            if (isLoading) {
                return;
            }
            pendingRetry = null;
            modal.className = 'social-terms-modal';
            document.body.classList.remove('body-no-scroll');
        }

        checkbox.addEventListener('change', function () {
            submitBtn.disabled = !checkbox.checked;
        });

        submitBtn.addEventListener('click', function () {
            if (isLoading || !checkbox.checked || !pendingRetry) {
                return;
            }
            setLoading(true);
            pendingRetry(marketingCheckbox.checked);
        });

        closeBtn.addEventListener('click', closeModal);

        modal.addEventListener('click', function (event) {
            // The 500px wrap column also catches clicks above/below the card,
            // so anything outside the card itself counts as a backdrop click.
            if (content && !content.contains(event.target)) {
                closeModal();
            }
        });
    })();
</script>
